release.summary_zh:
![0 5 5](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3890945/105014988-575cb680-5a41-11eb-90d5-d942d28184b2.png)

发行说明

Sandboxie Plus 1.18.8 / Classic 5.73.8 为 Firefox 和其他沙盒浏览器带来了重要的兼容性改进
release.raw_body: ![0 5 5](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3890945/105014988-575cb680-5a41-11eb-90d5-d942d28184b2.png) ### Release Notes Sandboxie Plus 1.18.8 / Classic 5.73.8 brings important compatibility improvements for Firefox and other sandboxed browsers, with a particular focus on fixing video playback issues. Video playback now works correctly in sandboxed Firefox on websites such as Disney, Amazon Prime, Netflix, TVNZ and ESPN that rely on mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo() to check media support before starting playback. This resolves an issue that could leave videos unable to start on affected sites. The release also improves AppContainer handling used by browsers and other applications to isolate their child processes. Fixes address missing sandbox permissions and overly restrictive substitute tokens that could prevent these processes from starting or accessing required system resources. Microsoft Edge can again use the corrected substitute token without enabling UnRestrictAppContainerToken by default. A security fix addresses an out-of-bounds read in the GUI proxy’s MapWindowPoints handler that could expose service heap data to sandboxed callers. The Import Boxes workflow has also been corrected, allowing users to choose where imported sandboxes are created. For existing sandboxes, the new fixboxdacls command in KmdUtil.exe adds missing AppContainer access permissions. Advanced configuration options provide additional control: KeepBroadGroupsInAppContainerToken=n restores the previous all-deny-only substitute token behavior, NeutralizeLowBoxToken=n allows direct NtCreateLowBoxToken calls through, and FakeAppContainerToken=n now allows sandboxed programs to create real AppContainer child processes. For a full list of changes please review the [change log](https://github.com/sandboxie-plus/Sandboxie/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#1188--5738---2026-10-17). #### You can support the project through donations, any help will be greatly appreciated. [](https://xanasoft.com/go.php?to=donate) #### If you have issues with an update installation, just uninstall the previous version keeping the sandboxie.ini and reinstall the new build.

## :mega: 获取其他软件包 / How to Get Other Packages

### 方式 1：添加软件源 / Method 1: Add Software Source

  Follow the instructions in the [openwrt-passwall-build](https://github.com/moetayuko/openwrt-passwall-build) repository to add the provided software source to your device, then install directly using the package manager.

### 方式 2：手动下载并安装 / Method 2: Manual Download and Install

* 从 [SourceForge](https://sourceforge.net/projects/openwrt-passwall-build/files/) 下载预构建的软件包。
  Download prebuilt packages from [SourceForge](https://sourceforge.net/projects/openwrt-passwall-build/files/).

* 将文件上传到您的设备，使用 Shell 命令进行安装。
  Upload files to your device, install it with shell command.

ipk
```
opkg install /path/to/package.ipk
```
apk
```
apk add --allow-untrusted /path/to/package.apk
```

:warning: 请将 /path/to/package 替换为实际下载的软件包路径。
- Replace /path/to/package with the actual path of the downloaded packages.

---
## :rocket: 配套固件与工具 / Firmwares & Tools

### :fire: [OpenWrtAction](https://github.com/smallprogram/OpenWrtAction) —— 集成 Passwall 的 CI 固件 / Ready-to-use firmware with Passwall
* 集成官方 OpenWrt 25.12、ImmortalWrt 25.12、Lean (Snapshot) 固件，支持 x86、R2S、R2C、R4S、R5S、R5C、H66K、H68K、H69K、R66S、R68S 等设备，刷入即用。
  Firmware built on official OpenWrt 25.12, ImmortalWrt 25.12 and Lean (Snapshot), supporting x86, R2S, R2C, R4S, R5S, R5C, H66K, H68K, H69K, R66S, R68S and more.
* 支持 GitHub 一键更新：直接从 GitHub Releases 在线升级固件，无需手动下载和刷写。
  Supports one-click GitHub update: upgrade the firmware online straight from GitHub Releases, no manual download or flashing needed.

### :package: [Are-u-ok](https://github.com/bcseputetto/Are-u-ok) —— iStoreOS .run 更新包 / iStoreOS .run update packages
* 为 iStoreOS 提供 .run 格式更新包，无需重刷固件，上传执行即可安装/升级。
  Provides .run update packages for iStoreOS — no reflashing needed, just upload and run.
